summary: P3: LAW-130 boundary/tooling-failure contract and precision contract.

contract.operator: LAW-130 uses the canonical inclusive threshold operator (<==).
contract.precision: The verdict is computed from the SAME rounded value that is reported (observed = round(clash_score, 2)), so the displayed value and status never contradict. Exposed as result field precision='verdict evaluates the reported rounded observed value'.
contract.sample_semantics: sample is the valid measurement sample (atom input count on success). On MEASUREMENT_FAILED / NOT_MEASURED sample=0 and the diagnostic input atom count is exposed separately as atom_input_count; a failure never implies a successful sample.

tests: adjudicator: failed deterministic measurement -> INDETERMINATE (not PASS)

test_count.local: python -m pytest tests/ --q under PYTHONUTF8=1: 580 passed, 10 pre-existing baseline failures.
